description.zh:
跨地域复制快照的保留时间，单位为天。取值范围：

- -1：永久保存。
- 1~65535：指定保存天数。

默认值为-1。
description.en:
The retention period of cross-region snapshot replicas. Unit: days. Valid values:

- -1: permanently retained.
- 1 to 65535: the specified number of days for which snapshot replicas are retained.

Default value: -1.

description.zh: 快照跨地域复制加密参数对象
description.en: The encryption parameter for cross-region snapshot replication.

description.zh:
是否允许自动跨地域复制。

- true：允许。
- false：不允许。
description.en:
Specifies whether to allow automatic cross-region replication.

- true: allowed.
- false: not allowed.

description.zh: 跨地域复制快照的目标地域。目前支持设置一个目标地域。
description.en: The destination region for cross-region snapshot replication. You can set one destination region.

description.zh: 目标自动快照策略ID。您可以调用[DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyEx](~~25530~~)查看您可用的自动快照策略。
description.en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy. You can call [DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyEx](~~25530~~) to query available automatic snapshot policies.

description.zh: 自动快照策略的名称。如果参数为空则代表不修改。
description.en: The name of the automatic snapshot policy. If this parameter is left empty, the name is not modified.

description.zh: 自动快照策略所在的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the automatic snapshot policy. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
自动快照的重复日期，单位为天，周期为星期。取值范围为1~7，如1表示周一。

当一星期内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点：

- 最多传入7个时间点。
- 多个时间点用一个格式类似`"1", "2", … "7"`的JSON数组表示，时间点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en:
The days of the week on which automatic snapshots are created. Unit: days. The cycle is weekly. Valid values: 1 to 7. For example, 1 indicates Monday.

To create multiple automatic snapshots within a week, specify multiple days:

- You can specify up to 7 days.
- Specify multiple days in a JSON array in the format of `"1", "2", … "7"`. Separate the days with commas (,).

description.zh:
自动快照的保留时间，单位为天。取值范围：

- -1：永久保存。
- 1~65536：指定保存天数。

默认值为-1。
description.en:
The retention period of automatic snapshots. Unit: days. Valid values:

- -1: permanently retained.
- 1 to 65536: the specified number of days for which snapshots are retained.

Default value: -1.

description.zh:
自动快照的创建时间点。使用UTC +8时间，单位为小时。取值范围为0~23，代表00:00至23:00共24个时间点，如1表示01:00。

当一天内需要创建多次自动快照时，可以传入多个时间点：

- 最多传入24个时间点。
- 多个时间点用一个格式类似`"0", "1", … "23"`的JSON数组表示，时间点之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en:
The points in time at which automatic snapshots are created. The time is displayed in UTC+8. Unit: hours. Valid values: 0 to 23, which correspond to the 24 points in time from 00:00 to 23:00. For example, 1 indicates 01:00.

To create multiple automatic snapshots within a day, specify multiple points in time:

- You can specify up to 24 points in time.
- Specify multiple points in time in a JSON array in the format of `"0", "1", … "23"`. Separate the points in time with commas (,).

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：

- 不支持修改系统策略。
- 修改自动快照策略后，之前已应用该策略的云盘随即执行修改后的自动快照策略。
- 已启用快照跨地域复制且在未配置加密参数场景下，加密快照默认使用目的端服务密钥进行加密拷贝。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, take note of the following items:

- System policies cannot be modified.
- After you modify an automatic snapshot policy, the disks to which the policy has been applied immediately execute the modified policy.
- If cross-region snapshot replication is enabled and no encryption parameters are configured, encrypted snapshots are encrypted by using the service key of the destination region by default.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs modify-auto-snapshot-policy-ex --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-bp12m37ccmxvbmi50000 --auto-snapshot-policy-name SPTestName --time-points 0_,_1 --repeat-weekdays 1_,_7 --retention-days 30 --enable-cross-region-copy false --target-copy-regions cn-hangzhou --copied-snapshots-retention-days 30 --copy-encryption-configuration '{"KMSKeyId":"0e478b7a-4262-4802-b8cb-00d3fb40826X","Encrypted":false,"Arn":[{"AssumeRoleFor":1000000000,"RoleType":"hide","Rolearn":"hide"}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicyEx --region cn-hangzhou --repeatWeekdays '1_,_7' --autoSnapshotPolicyId 'sp-bp12m37ccmxvbmi50000' --CopyEncryptionConfiguration.Arn.1.Rolearn hide --CopyEncryptionConfiguration.Arn.1.AssumeRoleFor 1000000000 --CopyEncryptionConfiguration.KMSKeyId '0e478b7a-4262-4802-b8cb-00d3fb40826X' --timePoints '0_,_1' --CopiedSnapshotsRetentionDays 30 --TargetCopyRegions 'cn-hangzhou' --regionId 'cn-hangzhou' --autoSnapshotPolicyName SPTestName --retentionDays 30 --CopyEncryptionConfiguration.Encrypted false --CopyEncryptionConfiguration.Arn.1.RoleType hide --EnableCrossRegionCopy false --method POST --force
